description: ACCMIP anthropogenic and biomass burning emissions dataset is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Bioenergy, Environment", published or maintained by Lamarque, J.-F (National Center for Atmospheric Research). In support of the fifth IPCC-AR5 (Intergovernmental Panel for Climate Change Assessment Report 5), the ACCMIP historical emissions dataset has been developed (Lamarque et al, 2010), together with the emissions projections of the so-called RCPs (Representation Concentration Pathways), described in van Vuuren et al., 2010. Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa, East Asia and the Pacific, Europe and Central Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, the Middle East and North Africa, South Asia. It has 2 files in ZIP, PDF. The portal files it under Bioenergy, Environment. The portal gives 2010 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
